definitions.explanation: A rise in profit compared with the previous period. Standard vocabulary in earnings reports and business news, where it is contrasted with {増収|ぞうしゅう} (higher revenue).

examples.japanese: ⟦{今期|こんき}→今期：29530_konki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{増益|ぞうえき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦コスト→コスト：06666_kosuto⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}→削減：11789_sakugen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{増益|ぞうえき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながった。
examples.english: Cost cutting led to higher profits.

examples.japanese: {三期|さんき}⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{増益|ぞうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}→達成：04816_tassei⟧し、⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The company achieved a third straight term of profit growth, and its share price rose as well.

notes:
From {増|ぞう} (increase) + ⟦{益|えき}→益：02275_eki⟧ (profit, gain). Used as a noun with なる or ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧; {増益|ぞうえき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is not standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{増収|ぞうしゅう}→増収：30424_zoushuu⟧{増益|ぞうえき}: higher revenue and higher profit (a set phrase in earnings reports)
- ⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な{増益|ぞうえき}: a sharp rise in profit
- ⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧{増益|ぞうえき}: consecutive periods of profit growth
- {増益|ぞうえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見込|みこ}む→見込む：08315_mikomu⟧: to forecast higher profit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{減益|げんえき}→減益：13511_geneki⟧: decreased profit — the direct opposite
- ⟦{増収|ぞうしゅう}→増収：30424_zoushuu⟧: increased revenue — the money taken in, before costs; a company can post ⟦{増収|ぞうしゅう}→増収：30424_zoushuu⟧⟦{減益|げんえき}→減益：13511_geneki⟧ (higher sales but lower profit)
